V10.0.12/service update (#34)

🔧 add repository standards (.editorconfig, .gitattributes, global.json)
⬆️ upgrade test infrastructure to Microsoft.Testing.Platform with xunit v4.0.0
💬 refresh contributing guidelines
📝 add v10.0.12 changelog entry

pull_request.title: V10.0.12/service update
pull_request.body:
This is a service update that focuses on package dependencies.

Automated changes:
- Codebelt/Cuemon package versions bumped to latest compatible
- PackageReleaseNotes.txt updated for v10.0.12
- CHANGELOG.md entry added for v10.0.12

Note: Third-party packages (Microsoft.Extensions.*, BenchmarkDotNet, etc.) are not auto-updated.
Use Dependabot or manual updates for those.

Generated by codebelt-aicia
Triggered by: xunit @ 12.0.1

pr_commits.message:
🔧 add repository standards configuration

Add .editorconfig for code style enforcement, .gitattributes for line ending normalization, and global.json to specify the Microsoft.Testing.Platform test runner.

⬆️ upgrade test infrastructure dependencies

Migrate test coverage from coverlet to Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage (18.11.2). Upgrade xunit.v3 from 3.2.2 to 4.0.0, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk to 18.10.0, and MinVer to 8.0.0. These upgrades align with the Microsoft Testing Platform adoption and provide improved tooling support.

💬 update contributing guidelines

Modernize CONTRIBUTING.md with contemporary Codebelt practices. Clarify repository structure, build and test procedures, integration environment setup, package creation, pull request workflow, and coding guidelines. Include guidance for local development using WSL-Ubuntu and Docker-Ubuntu test environments.
